question: How does satellite imagery help in managing natural disasters in India?

options.text: By creating 3D video games of landscapes
By connecting people to mobile towers
By providing real-time data on floods, cyclones and droughts

solution:
The correct answer is __**By providing real-time data on floods, cyclones and droughts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Satellite imagery** is a crucial tool in natural disaster management as it provides **real-time data** on disasters like floods, cyclones, droughts, and other natural calamities.

• It aids in **monitoring the progression of natural disasters** by capturing high-resolution images, which enable authorities to take timely actions to mitigate damage and save lives.

• In India, organizations like the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** play a significant role in providing satellite data for disaster management through systems like the **National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC)**.

• For floods, satellite imagery helps identify **inundated areas**, potential breaches
